+"""One episode controller for rcb-limited/2.2 spoons_in_pot.
+
+Run one item at a time, inspecting each returned image before continuing:
+    python /app/output/gen.py red
+
+The targets below are in the env-local frame, measured from calibrated RGB-D views.
+The pickup locations are on clear wooden handle sections. The place target offsets
+the pickup point to put the spoon's visible lengthwise midpoint over the pot center.
+"""
+import sys
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0])  # fingertips toward table
+POT = np.array([0.509, 0.012])
+
+# grasp xy, and object-centre xy relative to the grasp point
+ITEMS = {
+    # Red spoon on the far plate. Its wooden handle runs toward +y and +x.
+    "red": ((0.312, -0.172), (-0.012, -0.036)),
+    # The two solid green ladles on the near plate; identified after the red pick.
+    "green_a": ((0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0)),
+    "green_b": ((0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0)),
+}
+
+
+def pose(xy, z, grip):
+    return np.r_[float(xy[0]), float(xy[1]), float(z), DOWN, float(grip)].astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def go(robot, xy, z, grip, label):
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", pose(xy, z, grip), video="none", note=label)
+    print(label, json.dumps({k: result.meta.get(k) for k in
+          ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped", "control_steps_chunk", "sim_time_s")}, default=str))
+    print("tcp", np.asarray(result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", []))[8:15].tolist())
+    print("opening", result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[24:25])
+    return result
+
+
+def save_view(robot, name):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    from PIL import Image
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(f"/app/output/{name}_{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    print("observation", json.dumps({"sim_time_s": obs.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
+          "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+          "tcp": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15]}, default=lambda a: np.asarray(a).tolist()))
+
+
+def pick_place(item):
+    if item not in ITEMS:
+        raise SystemExit(f"choose one of: {', '.join(ITEMS)}")
+    grasp, offset = map(np.asarray, ITEMS[item])
+    if np.allclose(grasp, 0):
+        raise SystemExit(f"{item} target has not been calibrated yet")
+    place = POT + offset
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    if obs.meta.get("done"):
+        print("episode already done", obs.meta.get("reason")); return
+    print("before", json.dumps({"sim_time_s": obs.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
+          "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), "tcp": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15]},
+          default=lambda a: np.asarray(a).tolist()))
+    save_view(robot, f"before_{item}")
+
+    # Move above the free handle, descend until the pads overlap the handle height,
+    # close, and lift clear of the table.
+    go(robot, grasp, 0.17, 0.0, f"{item}: approach")
+    go(robot, grasp, 0.012, 0.0, f"{item}: descend")
+    go(robot, grasp, 0.012, 1.0, f"{item}: close")
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    opening = float(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][24])
+    print("closed opening", opening)
+    save_view(robot, f"closed_{item}")
+
+    go(robot, grasp, 0.22, 1.0, f"{item}: lift")
+    go(robot, place, 0.22, 1.0, f"{item}: carry")
+    go(robot, place, 0.19, 1.0, f"{item}: over pot")
+    go(robot, place, 0.19, 0.0, f"{item}: release")
+    # Retreat promptly so the falling spoon cannot contact the gripper.
+    go(robot, place, 0.34, 0.0, f"{item}: retreat")
+    obs = robot.get_obs(seconds=0.6, video="none")
+    print("after", json.dumps({"done": obs.meta.get("done"), "reason": obs.meta.get("reason"),
+          "sim_time_s": obs.meta.get("sim_time_s"), "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s")}, default=str))
+    save_view(robot, f"after_{item}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    pick_place(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "red")
